Which should go to Tobias: $1,591 (the net rate after the 14% discount), $1,850 (gross), or $1,313 (if you have a newer figure I can't see)? Once you confirm, I'll save the draft to Tobias (trendle@pemberline.com) and let you know. Nothing has been drafted or sent yet.
